les: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
kaps_punt: Leesvaardighede: lees met begrip en die gebruik van 'n woordeboek: Lees oor die gevare van misbruik van middels: herroep en vertel.

items.bewering: Sy het ook gesê dat die meeste damptoestelle se vloeistof nikotien bevat.
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: CDC, 'E-Cigarette Use Among Youth' (cdc.gov/tobacco/e-cigarettes/youth.html): 'Most e-cigarettes contain nicotine, which is highly addictive.' South African learners specifically: UCT REEP summary of the Lancet eClinicalMedicine study of more than 25 000 high-school learners in 52 schools (commerce.uct.ac.za, 26 Jan 2025): '88% said they used vapes that contain nicotine.' A CDC-hosted California study of devices taken from learners at 16 high schools found nicotine in 98.1% of samples (stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/159347). 'Die meeste' is the right quantifier: the lesson does not say every vape contains nicotine, and some do not.

items.bewering: Nikotien maak dit moeilik om op te hou.
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: CDC youth e-cigarette page: nicotine 'is highly addictive' and harms the developing adolescent brain. A JAMA Network Open study (Nov 2025, US national youth survey data, reported by HealthDay and the Boston Globe) found that the share of daily teen vapers who tried to quit and failed rose from 28% to 53% between 2020 and 2024. The UCT study of SA learners reports high dependence: about 47% vape within an hour of waking, and about 15% say they are addicted. Ruan in the story wants to stop and cannot, which matches this.

items.bewering: Die laaste ruk het hy in elke wedstryd meer dikwels gaan staan met sy hande op sy knieë. Tumelo het gesien hoe hy vinniger uitasem raak as vroeër. ... Hy het gesê hy gebruik die damptoestel al 'n ruk (implied: vaping is linked to getting out of breath sooner)
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: NHLBI news release (nhlbi.nih.gov, 2023) on Tackett et al., Thorax 2024;79(2):163-168, Southern California Children's Health Study, about 2 100 teenagers: past-30-day vapers had 78% higher odds of shortness of breath than never-users. The link stayed significant after adjusting for cigarette and cannabis use and second-hand exposure. Also BMC Medicine 2024 (pubmed 38807205), 39 214 youth aged 16-19 in Canada, England and the US: vaping is associated with respiratory symptoms. The evidence shows an association, not proven cause. The story's wording is sound because it shows only what Tumelo sees, put next to Ruan's vaping, and never states that vaping caused it. A sentence saying the damptoestel MADE him breathless would go further than the evidence.

items.bewering: Sy het gesê dat grootmense by die skool en by die kliniek kan help om die regte hulp te kry.
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: SA sources. The South African tobacco smoking cessation clinical practice guideline (van Zyl-Smit et al., SAMJ 2013, open.uct.ac.za) says every clinical setting should identify tobacco users and counsel them. In a survey of primary-care clinic staff in the Northern Cape (Health SA Gesondheid 2024, hsag.co.za), 89.7% said cessation counselling is part of their job. The NCAS Quitline is a national service clinics can refer to. Caveat for the reader, not a contradiction: SA cessation support is thin and uneven. Bhekisisa reported in 2025, which I could only reach through search snippets, that there are almost no quit programmes aimed at vapers, and the same staff survey found 53.9% did not know the guideline. The claim holds because it is modest. It says adults can help a child FIND the right help, not that a clinic runs a quit programme. A stronger wording such as 'die kliniek sal hom help ophou' would not be supported.

items.bewering: Tumelo en Anele het dit elke pouse gebruik, want dit was die vinnigste pad.
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: Not a claim about the world. It is a detail inside the story, about a made-up school and a made-up path, so no source can confirm or contradict it. Recorded because every superlative must be an item.

items.bewering: Ruan was verlede jaar die vinnigste speler in die hele groep.
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: Not a claim about the world. It is about a made-up character, so no source applies. It does narrative work by setting up the contrast with how Ruan tires now. Recorded because every superlative must be an item.

items.bewering: Toe het Ruan 'n damptoestel uit sy sak gehaal ... Hy het gesê hy gebruik die damptoestel al 'n ruk en wil eintlik ophou. (premise: children of primary-school age are offered vapes by older learners)
items.blok: Wat agter die saal gebeur het
items.bron: UCT/Lancet eClinicalMedicine study (commerce.uct.ac.za, 2025; EWN, 7 Mar 2025): about 9% of SA Grade 8 learners already vape and 16.8% of all sampled learners currently vape, so younger children meeting older learners who vape is realistic in SA. The study surveyed only fee-paying schools with internet access, which limits how far it generalises, but it does not contradict the story. Neither this item nor any other in the story claims a number.

opsomming: Elke kontroleerbare bewering in die leesstuk klop met bronne: 'die meeste' damptoestelle bevat nikotien (CDC; UCT se studie van SA-leerders: 88%), nikotien maak ophou moeilik, en die vroeëre uitasem van 'n jong dampgebruiker word deur assosiasiestudies gestaaf en word nie as bewese oorsaak gestel nie; die mens moet net weet dat die sin oor hulp by die kliniek waar is omdat dit beskeie is (grootmense kan help om hulp te vind), want hulp om op te hou damp is in Suid-Afrika dun en ongelyk, en enige sterker bewoording sal nie gestaaf wees nie.
